instructions: Add one entry per prospect using a chain:contract key.
Within each prospect, add only criteria that have been reviewed, keyed by the exact criterion key from config/qualification_criteria.json.

Each criterion status must be confirmed, not_present, or unknown. Confirmed means evidence supports the criterion definition; not_present means evidence reviewed does not support it. Use unknown when evidence is insufficient.
confirmed and not_present require evidence_urls and evidence_timestamps arrays with the same non-zero length. URLs must be absolute HTTP(S), and timestamps must be ISO 8601 with a timezone.
A buying-trigger record does not automatically confirm buying_trigger_and_timing. The reviewer must assess the criterion definition and cite evidence.
Criterion weights are loaded from config/qualification_criteria.json; do not include or override weights here.
Risk flags and manual holds remain independent of the score. No automated outreach is enabled.
This is a human-review input. Do not add secrets or private credentials.
